question: Find the first names and number of works of all artists who have at least two paintings?
statements: CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "artists" AS SELECT "artistid" AS "artistid", "lname" AS "lname", "fname" AS "fname", "year_type" AS "year_type", "year_value" AS "year_value" FROM table_1;

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "paintings" AS SELECT "paintingid" AS "paintingid", "title" AS "title", "year" AS "year", "height_mm" AS "height_mm", "width_mm" AS "width_mm", "medium" AS "medium", "mediumon" AS "mediumon", "location" AS "location", "painterid" AS "painterid" FROM table_2;

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
SELECT a.fname AS first_name, COUNT(p.paintingid) AS num_works
FROM artists a
JOIN paintings p
  ON p.painterid = a.artistid
GROUP BY a.fname
HAVING COUNT(p.paintingid) >= 2
ORDER BY num_works DESC, first_name ASC
